ANNEX.text:
[LOUD STATIC]

...${c.lead} here. The corridor walls are absorbing sound. I yelled for ${c.custodian} earlier and the echo didn't come back.

...

It just stopped.

[CLICK]

ARCHIVE.text:
[PAGES TURNING, CLOSE BREATHING]

...the codes were never to keep us out. The records lock is the pour year and the open pen, two digits each, and I am saying it out loud onto tape because paper here gets reclassified and I have watched it happen. Twice.

[CLICK]

IMPOUND.text:
[CHAINLINK SHIVERING]

...I found ${c.lost}'s recorder in the cage. It's still spinning. There's no tape inside it. I'm recording this onto the outside of it, somehow.

[CLICK]

INCINERATOR.text:
[ROAR OF COMBUSTION, THEN IT DROPS OUT ENTIRELY]

... for ${hrs} hours. ${c.archivist} was right. Kill the burners and the sound underneath them doesn't stop. It isn't a machine; it's alive and it breathes. [STATIC]

BOARDROOM.text:
[CHAIRS BEING PULLED OUT, COUNTED ALOUD] ...eleven.

[PAUSE]

Eleven of us came in. Somebody tell me why there are twelve of us now, and why can't I tell which one of you is not supposed to be here?

[CLICK]

SERVER.text:
[FAN NOISE, THEN SUDDEN SILENCE]

...there. Fans are off. You can hear it now. Like I said, that's not the cooling unit. That's a carrier signal and it's been hiding under the fan noise this whole time.

[STATIC]

CHECKPOINT.text:
[GATE CYCLING REPEATEDLY, NOBODY PASSING]

...forty-one out, forty in, and the gate is still counting.

${c.lost} scanned in at hour ${hrs} and the machine still thinks they're inside.

So do I.

[CLICK]

ATRIUM.text:
[A CART WHEEL TICKING, FAR BELOW]

...I walked up. That's the part I need on record. There is no stair to this tier and I walked up, and I can see the aisles from here, and they are not where the planogram says they are.

[CLICK]

CLINIC.text:
[PEN ON PAPER, UNHURRIED]

...I'm holding the chart, not the pen. That's ${c.lost}'s hand, I'd know it anywhere, and it is writing down what I'm saying while I say it.

[CLICK]

MAINTENANCE.text:
TAPE MEASURE RUNNING OUT, THEN RETRACTING]

...one hundred and six down.

[PAUSE]

Ninety-eight up. Same shaft.

I'm going to keep doing this until one of us gives up.

[CLICK]

CHASM.text:
[WIND, AND A LONG DROP UNDER IT]

...there's somebody on the far catwalk. I'm looking straight at them. That span was cut for scrap before we opened. They just waved at me with ${c.lost}'s arm.

[STATIC]
